title: Kenyan Wagyu Skewers
description: A fusion of Kenyan and Japanese flavors, featuring tender Wagyu beef, roasted to perfection on skewers.

ingredients.name: Kenyan spices
ingredients.notes: A blend of turmeric, cumin, coriander, and chili powder

instructions: Thread Wagyu beef, onions, bell peppers, tomatoes, and cilantro onto skewers, leaving space between each piece.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with Kenyan spices, salt, and black pepper.
Place skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until Wagyu beef is cooked to desired level of doneness.
Remove skewers from oven and brush with lime juice.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
